harper: Kicking off a short ownership-verification sweep (15:00 PT). Scope: admin roles with last auth >45d, KMS grants to non-org principals, and SAs only referenced in cron metadata. Outcome: ownership-verification tickets + a revoke-simulation CSV (no automatic removals).
leo: Confirming: tickets only, no automated role/key deletions, right?
harper: Right. We only simulate revokes in the CSV. Actual changes require explicit oncall signoff.
niko: Suggest we compute an "exposed-risk-score" to prioritize: external_principal (1.5x) * days_since_last_use + infra_untracked_bonus. Draft BigQuery snippet to produce last_use + external flag + infra_state diff: 
```sql
SELECT
  rb.resource_name AS resource,
  rb.principal AS principal,
  MAX(audit.timestamp) AS last_use,
  CASE WHEN rb.principal LIKE "%@redwood" THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS external_principal,
  IFNULL(tf.tracked, FALSE) AS infra_tracked,
  (CASE WHEN external_principal THEN 1.5 ELSE 1 END) * DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), DATE(MAX(audit.timestamp)), DAY) + (IF(infra_tracked, 0, 10)) AS exposed_risk_score
FROM `org.audit_logs.*` AS audit
JOIN `org.iam_bindings` AS rb ON audit.resource_name = rb.resource_name
LEFT JOIN `infra.tfstate_bindings` AS tf ON rb.resource_name = tf.resource_name
GROUP BY resource, principal, external_principal, infra_tracked
ORDER BY exposed_risk_score DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```

sre-oncall: Owner notifications historically generate pages if owner aliases are oncall. Please add header X-Notify-Quiet for aliases and throttle to 45/hr. Also include a 1-click "I acknowledge ownership" link to reduce chatter.
policy: Add a flag "log_coverage" when retention < 90d so reviewers know audit logs are partial and to request extra owner evidence.
maya: Quick gcloud snippet to extract recent decrypts per key (useful for low-priority exemptions):
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --limit=200 --freshness=90d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, resource.labels.key_name)'
```
pipe this into the ticket body so owners see recent activity.

harper: Plan: 1) create ownership-verification tickets with last_use snippets + infra_tracked flag 2) 5-day owner response window 3) escalate ownerless or high exposed_risk_score items to infra-oncall for manual review 4) oncall runs manual revoke if approved. Volunteers: @niko for query tuning and CSV generator, @maya for ticket body template, @leo to coordinate partner outreach for external principals.
niko: I'll output two revoke-simulation CSVs: conservative.csv (exclude cron-only & rotation_recent & infra_tracked) and aggressive.csv (include infra_untracked but still mark for manual signoff). We'll attach both to tickets.
sre-oncall: For escalation: if a key is ownerless + external_principal + recent decrypts, treat as Incident candidate and page irs@redwood immediately. Also ensure the oncall checklist includes rotation checks and dependent-service discovery before any revoke.
policy: We'll add guidance to the ticket template: if log_coverage=partial, require at least one secondary proof (deploy pipeline run, terraform commit, or app owner note) before revoking.
maya: Template will include: last 3 actors, infra_tracked flag, log_coverage status, exposed_risk_score, and two quick actions: [I acknowledge ownership] or [Request help]. The latter opens a follow-up with access-cert-steward.
harper: access-bot will create tickets now. Expect rate-limited emails. Posting summary here after tickets created.

harper: Thanks team. One more ask: add a brief rollback snippet in the runbook for oncall (re-grant plan + timeline) so recoveries are fast if a revoke breaks something. Runbook path: /runbooks/access/ownership-verification.md
